nodes.label: Fault F44.2 — margin narrowing misattributed to 4d when the runner-up is 5p
A margin may never be quoted without the channel it is a margin against
nodes.rationale: margin = D[runner-up] - D[winner] and names nothing; the `order` column names the runner-up. Between Z=37 and Z=38 the runner-up changes identity from 4d to 5p, so the two compared margins are gaps between different pairs. The 5s-4d gap the finding meant is flat (0.07991 -> 0.07799). A misattributed MEASUREMENT is exempt from prediction scoring and therefore propagates further than a failed prediction; the remedy is to report margin as '0.05639 (vs 5p)'.
